13-Stage Market Data Pipeline

Defensive, audited ingestion sequence from wire socket to TimescaleDB persistence

STAGE 01 Provider Socket TCP / WS Frame
STAGE 02 Raw Ingestion UUID Assigned
STAGE 03 Schema Validator Pydantic v2 Type
STAGE 04 Symbol Mapping Canonical ID
STAGE 05 Normalization Decimal Prec
STAGE 06 Timestamp Check Monotonic UTC
STAGE 07 Quality Engine Spread & Invariant
STAGE 08 Conflict Detect Divergence <0.15%
STAGE 09 TimescaleDB Hypertable Insert
STAGE 10 Redis Pub/Sub Live Broadcast
STAGE 11 Observability Prometheus Metric
STAGE 12 MinIO Archive Raw Payload S3
STAGE 13 Immutable Audit Trail SHA-256 Chained Hash

Data Quality & Invariant Engine

Real-time mathematical assertion suite preventing corrupted, inverted, or drifted market data

INVARIANT #1 PASS (VERIFIED)
Crossed Market Guard

Asserts Ask ≥ Bid. Instantly isolates quotes with negative or crossed spreads.

INVARIANT #2 PASS (VERIFIED)
OHLC Mathematical Invariant

Asserts High ≥ max(O,C) and Low ≤ min(O,C). Rejects corrupted bar geometries.

INVARIANT #3 PASS (VERIFIED)
Monotonic Clock Drift

Tolerates max 3000ms clock skew. Rejects future timestamps (>1000ms drift).

INVARIANT #4 PASS (VERIFIED)
SimHash Deduplicator

Groups wire stories by 64-bit Hamming distance to prevent duplicate news alert loops.
